title: IT Software Solutions Engineeer
description:
Software Solutions Engineer

Our Client is looking for an IT Software Solutions Engineer who combines software development, technical troubleshooting, and strong customer service skills. This position will work directly with customers and internal teams to understand technical needs, troubleshoot problems, write and modify code, and develop practical software solutions. The ideal candidate enjoys programming, problem solving, and helping people, with the ability to translate customer needs into effective technical solutions and explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical users.

Job Roles and Responsibilities

Provide professional and responsive technical support to customers and internal team members
Communicate with customers by phone, email, and other channels to identify and resolve technical issues
Write, modify, test, and maintain code to improve software functionality and develop customized solutions
Assist with software development, debugging, testing, implementation, and ongoing maintenance
Troubleshoot software, computer, application, and other technology related issues
Investigate technical problems, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions
Configure and maintain software applications and systems
Translate customer and business requirements into practical technical solutions
Assist with software integrations, APIs, databases, data management, and automation
Identify opportunities to improve software functionality, workflows, and business processes
Test new software features, updates, integrations, and custom code
Document technical processes, software solutions, customer issues, and procedures
Explain technical information clearly to technical and nontechnical customers
Follow up with customers to ensure technical issues are fully resolved
Collaborate with other departments to improve software functionality, operational efficiency, and customer experience
Maintain positive customer relationships and take ownership of issues through resolution
Stay current with programming languages, software development tools, and emerging technologies

Qualifications And Certifications

Strong problem solving and analytical skills
Genuine interest in coding, programming, software development, and technology
Experience with or willingness to learn software development and programming
Strong troubleshooting and technical problem solving abilities
Strong customer service, interpersonal, and communication skills
Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to individuals without a technical background
Ability to learn new programming languages, software applications, and systems quickly
Ability to work independently and take ownership of problems through resolution
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
Ability to prioritize multiple projects, technical issues, and customer needs
Professional, dependable, patient, and solution oriented approach
Experience with Python, JavaScript, C Sharp, SQL, or similar programming languages preferred
Experience with databases, APIs, software integrations, or automation preferred
Previous software development or programming experience preferred
Previous technical support or customer service experience preferred
Familiarity with Windows, networking, cloud based software, or business applications preferred
Experience supporting SaaS or business management software preferred
